title: Top 3 most wanted persons in Ilocos Region nabbed

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested the Ilocos Region’s three most wanted persons in separate operations across three provinces on Frisay, Nov. 27, the Police Regional Office 1 (PRO 1) said Saturday. The suspects, ranked Regional Top 1, Top 2 and Top 3 most wanted persons, were apprehended in separate operations involving police units and intelligence personnel. According to tje PRO 1, the Regional Top 1 most wanted person, a 53-year-old man from Bolinao, Pangasinan, was arrested in Sta. Cruz, Zambales, on a murder warrant, with no bail recommended.
